target_claim_text: When the historical analogs share the same Layer 2 macro-regime, directional concordance reaches 64.2%.
root_cause_explanation: In Sprint 02, the similarity engine was only executed on 10 events as a diagnostic smoke test (which yielded 10% concordance overall and 0% on matching macro regimes). The 64.2% figure was an unsubstantiated narrative claim inserted in SPRINT_02_RESEARCH_REPORT.md Line 49 without systematic empirical backing. Rigorous empirical evaluation across a stratified sample of 200 Discovery events reveals actual 24h concordance of 43.5% (all) and 45.1% (regime match), and 4h concordance of 48.0% (all) and 46.2% (regime match). None of the configurations approach 64.2%.
